_doc: P1.2 (D31/D38): private/source-only class-A root-bootstrap identities. Canonical bilingual sources and their two thin provider projections are derived FORMULAICALLY from `identity` (never hand-listed per-target) so the 26-target set stays exact and can't silently drift. Sole producer: registry.py -> publication.py root-bootstrap renderer. Canonical: packages/skiller/skills/repository-bootstrap/<identity>/{SKILL.ru.md,SKILL.md}. Projections: .claude/skills/<identity>/SKILL.md (Claude) and .agents/skills/<identity>/SKILL.md (Codex).
_class_a_content_version_doc: D38-frozen per-record `canonical_content_version`/`publication_unit` literal for the 13 class-A identities (`repository-bootstrap-map.json`) — embedded into every class-A projection body and NEVER moves, even when `configs/publication-versions.json` units.repository-bootstrap (the umbrella/lock version, currently bumped by P1.5 to 0.2.0) advances. Decoupling this from the umbrella version is what keeps the 26 class-A projection BYTES byte-identical across an owner bump (generated-artifact-version-v1.md byte-identical guard) — only the combined lock's own top-level `publication_unit` and the class-B projections track the umbrella version.
